text:
During a friendly opening, we appreciate your kind words; we looked into it and reviewed your concern that your companion animal travel experience did not reflect the care and clarity you expected from Aurelia Skyways. We understand how unsettling it is when a journey feels uncertain, especially when a companion animal is involved and every detail matters.

The Companion Animal Travel Desk has examined the handling notes, the service path, and the communication provided at each stage. Our review shows that the itinerary was managed through our standard welfare-focused process, but we also found that the explanation given to you did not fully ease your concerns or set out the steps in a reassuring way. For that gap in communication, we offer our sincere apology.

Please be assured that safety takes priority over speed in every journey. When a concern is raised, we follow a calm stepwise review so that the animal's comfort, the passenger's understanding, and the operational checks are all considered together. In this case, the team confirmed that the required care measures were available, yet we recognize that service is measured not only by procedure but also by the confidence our passengers feel along the way.

We have shared your feedback with the team members involved and asked for closer attention to guidance, tone, and timely updates during companion animal arrangements. That coaching is part of our routine work and helps us strengthen the consistency of support across the desk. We also appreciate the chance to learn from your experience, because respectful communication is an essential part of safe travel.

If you travel with Aurelia Skyways again, please let us know in advance so we can arrange a careful review of your companion animal needs and ensure the desk is prepared to assist you with steady, clear support from the start. We value your trust and hope to restore your confidence in our service.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
